subject: english
question:
**Correct the sentence with the appropriate form of the underline verb.**

Parents should tell their children to exercise great care when __crossed__ busy roads.
solution:
The correct answer is **'crossing'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct form of the underlined verb in the sentence is '**crossing**'.
 
• A **gerund** is **a verb **form ending in "-**ing**" that functions as &l
